composition: Stone houses stacked under the Lucanian Dolomite spires · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera faces Castelmezzano from the valley below on a bright morning, the whole village climbing the slope beneath the jagged Lucanian Dolomite spires. The stone houses cluster across the center and right of the frame, their tiled roofs stepping upward, while the pale rock towers rear above them against a deep blue sky. The modelled 23 September 2026, 08:30 sun strikes the spires from the side, and the green forested flanks of the valley fill the left of the picture.
